name: Anwar Sadat
summary: Sadat succeeded Nasser, ended his socialist economic course with the infitah open-door policy, turned Egypt from the Soviet Union to the United States and made peace with Israel at Camp David. He ruled increasingly by decree, rigged elections, and jailed opponents of every camp before his assassination in 1981.
